description: Higher-Order Lattice Combinators (Cartesian Closed Category morphisms) for modular, language-agnostic control flow synthesis in STRATA.

cells.docstring: Lambda Abstraction / Morphism Definition: Encapsulates a parameterized sub-pipeline into a named, reusable Callable function with explicit signature and scope.
Anonymous Curried Morphism: Constructs an inline anonymous lambda closure mapping bound arguments to an expression.
Object Coalgebra Encapsulation: Defines a class state machine bundling internal typestate fields and member method morphisms.
Structural Recursion (Fixpoint Operator): Defines a self-referential recursive morphism with base predicate, base action, and inductive recursive step.
Branching Divide-and-Conquer Recursion: Recursively partitions a problem into subproblems, evaluates them recursively, and combines subproblem outputs (e.g. MergeSort, QuadTree, Tree Traversal).
Arbitrary N-Ary Conditional Dispatcher (if / elif ... / elif / else): Evaluates an ordered list of (predicate, action) pairs sequentially until one matches, falling back to default.
Hierarchical 2D Nested Iteration: Evaluates a loop inside a loop across outer and inner collections, threading an accumulated state forward across all coordinate points.
Ranked slice morphism: Sorts a collection in descending order via an extracted scalar key projection function and extracts the top K elements (e.g. largest K contours).

code_templates.cpp:
std::vector<{T}> {output_collection};
std::partial_sort_copy({collection}.begin(), {collection}.end(), std::back_inserter({output_collection}), {k}, [](const {T}& a, const {T}& b) { return {key_fn}(a) > {key_fn}(b); });

cells.docstring: Ranked bottom slice morphism: Sorts a collection in ascending order via an extracted scalar key projection function and extracts the smallest K elements.

code_templates.cpp:
std::vector<{T}> {output_collection};
std::partial_sort_copy({collection}.begin(), {collection}.end(), std::back_inserter({output_collection}), {k}, [](const {T}& a, const {T}& b) { return {key_fn}(a) < {key_fn}(b); });

cells.docstring: Element-wise Functor morphism: Applies a unary transformation to every element of a collection [T] -> [U].
Predicate Selection Sub-collection morphism: Filters elements of a collection matching a boolean predicate function.
Monadic Bind morphism: Maps each element to a collection and flattens the resulting collections into a single one-dimensional list.
cells.code_template: {output_collection} = [elem for sublist in ({transform}(item) for item in {collection}) for elem in sublist]

code_templates.python: {output_collection} = [elem for sublist in ({transform}(item) for item in {collection}) for elem in sublist]

cells.docstring: Catamorphism / Accumulator morphism: Iteratively applies a binary associative operator over a collection, folding it into a single accumulated State value.
Applicative Zipper morphism: Pairs elements from two lists, applying a binary zipper function to produce a unified list.
cells.code_template: {output_collection} = [{zipper}(a, b) for a, b in zip({collection_a}, {collection_b})]

code_templates.python: {output_collection} = [{zipper}(a, b) for a, b in zip({collection_a}, {collection_b})]

cells.docstring: Iterative State-Threading Loop: Sequentially iterates through a collection, feeding each element and threading the accumulated State forward.
Bounded Index Range Loop: Executes a counted loop over [start, stop) with step, threading state through each iteration.
Indexed Enumeration Map: Transforms each element alongside its integer index (idx, item) into an updated collection.
cells.code_template: {output_collection} = [{transform}(idx, item) for idx, item in enumerate({collection}, start={start_index})]

code_templates.python: {output_collection} = [{transform}(idx, item) for idx, item in enumerate({collection}, start={start_index})]
code_templates.rust: let {output_collection}: Vec<{U}> = {collection}.iter().enumerate().map(|(idx, item)| {transform}((idx as i64 + {start_index}) as i32, item)).collect();

cells.docstring: Inductive Fixpoint Monad: Continuously computes State -> State as long as cond_fn(State) remains true.
Safe Bounded Fixpoint Loop: Evaluates State -> State while cond_fn(State) is true, with a strict max_iters bound to guarantee termination.
Post-Condition Inductive Loop (do-while): Executes body_fn at least once, repeating until until_cond_fn(State) is true.
Coproduct / Sum Eliminator: Dispatches computation to either then_branch or else_branch based on a boolean condition flag.
Chained Conditional Dispatcher (if / elif / else): Evaluates primary and secondary boolean conditions sequentially to dispatch the corresponding operator.
Structural Pattern Matching / Switch: Dispatches against discrete discriminator values with a wildcard default fallback.
cells.code_template:
match {discriminator}:
    case _val if _val == {case_a_val}:
        {result} = {action_a}({data})
    case _val if _val == {case_b_val}:
        {result} = {action_b}({data})
    case _:
        {result} = {default_action}({data})

cells.docstring: Error Trap / Either Monad morphism: Safely evaluates an action, catching specific runtime exceptions and executing a fallback handler.
Guaranteed Cleanup Trap: Wraps action execution with exception recovery and a guaranteed finalizer hook executed under all conditions.
Branching Error Guard: Executes success_continuation solely if action completes with no exceptions; otherwise triggers fallback.
Resilience Retry Loop: Repeatedly attempts an action up to max_retries with exponential delay, falling back if all attempts fail.
Short-Circuit Search: Traverses a collection and returns the first element satisfying a predicate, or default_val if no match is found.
Universal Quantifier: Checks whether all elements of a collection satisfy a boolean predicate.
Existential Quantifier: Checks whether at least one element of a collection satisfies a boolean predicate.
Predicate Partition Morphism: Divides a collection into two complementary sub-collections: (satisfied, unsatisfied).
cells.code_template: {true_collection}, {false_collection} = ([x for x in {collection} if {predicate}(x)], [x for x in {collection} if not {predicate}(x)])

code_templates.python: {true_collection}, {false_collection} = ([x for x in {collection} if {predicate}(x)], [x for x in {collection} if not {predicate}(x)])

cells.docstring: Precondition Guard Clause: Asserts a boolean condition holds; if false, immediately yields fallback_val without evaluating action.
Bracket / RAII Context Manager: Acquires a managed resource, securely runs body_fn within the active context, and guarantees deterministic release.
